WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
), station_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    avg_bandusagepct,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS count_ratio
  FROM station_counts
)
SELECT observstation, avg_bandusagepct, telescope_count, count_ratio
FROM station_ratios
ORDER BY count_ratio DESC, observstation
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average telescope count is the arithmetic mean across every station in observatories, including stations with zero telescopes.
